diagnosis.summary: E1 shows LT-101 rising only +0.1 mm/min while nominal balance predicts +9.0 mm/min with pump on and demand 0.90 L/s. E2 shows independent dip-tape reading 1.835 m vs LT-101 logged 1.615 m at same time, a +220 mm discrepancy indicating LT-101 reads low. E3 measures pump delivery at 1.190 L/s, matching rated 1.200 L/s, ruling out pump delivery reduction. Together these indicate LT-101 is stuck low, causing the mass‑balance warning.
